failures_and_corrections: startup_config.preflight demanded WRITABILITY of PLANPILOT_BACKUP_DIR, contradicting the mandated production mount backups:/backups:ro — the container refused to serve deep-health forever (unbootable in production). Fixed: backup dir is a READ target (exists+readable in production; absent tolerated in development). Pinned by test_preflight_backup_dir_is_read_not_write_target.

deploy_gate.probe_docker ran `compose config --quiet` WITHOUT profiles (vacuous: services {} — profile-gated api/backup were never validated) and WITHOUT satisfying the required-secret interpolation (a missing PLANPILOT_AUTH_SECRET was misreported as 'compose.yaml REJECTED' = wrong-reason FAIL). Fixed: both profiles selected; constant throwaway placeholder secret injected subprocess-only; pinned by test_docker_live_daemon_broken_compose_is_fail.
Dockerfile lacked COPY data — production preflight refuses a missing factory root, so the image could never boot. Fixed: COPY data ./data added.

compose.yaml additional_contexts default was ../../planpilot-wheelhouse (two levels up) but the wheelhouse is a SIBLING of the repo (build_wheelhouse.DEFAULT_WHEEL_DIR). Fixed to ../planpilot-wheelhouse; overridable via PLANPILOT_WHEELHOUSE_DIR.

First container `up` refused startup with 'AUTH_SECRET shorter than 32' — a tooling redaction filter had mangled the shell export, producing a garbage secret. The refusal itself demonstrates the production secret gate fail-closed inside a real container. Fixed: secret generated into an env file (gen_secret.py) and sourced; final run logged the secret length as 48 (>=32 minimum) with the value never printed.

An earlier unit-suite draft had a live-`docker compose config` test whose pass/skip depended on ambient daemon state (unit count flapped 927+1skip/928). Removed: unit suite stays deterministic; the live render is covered by docker-live.log and the fake-daemon classification tests.
compose config RENDER (compose-config.yaml) echoes interpolated env values including the throwaway secret — excluded from the pack and scrubbed; acceptance lines ship in docker-live.log instead.
